summary: Separated immutable knowledge items from explicit holdings; sole-reader loss, surviving/unreadable artifacts, team unreachability, stale/conflicting claims, shared sources and private actor projections pass 41 focused tests and 85 total tests. Added deterministic three-holder replay and updated MA-02/03. No mechanism was removed.
reviewer: Assigned AE-004 Codex worker (author self-review; no independent domain reviewer or human participants)
review_notes: Substantively reviewed AE-003 source, tests, replay and ADRs after its passing receipt at entry. Reviewed typed holder identities, direct reading versus team union, immutable facts, pre-append failure atomicity, version-pinned access and retained uncertainty. Actual missing-module red and green outputs, all eight three-holder access combinations, relabeling/moved-holder cases and unchanged canonical replay results support this bounded disposition. See research/experiments/AE-004/review.md; no architecture acceptance implied.
limitations: Worker self-review only; independent controller validation, domain/architecture acceptance, integration and publication are not proven. No participants or empirical calibration.

Direct personal holdings and artifact reader lists only; team availability is a union of members access, not automatic sharing or graph routing. Communication, discovery, learning and full replacement are future work.
Stale/current/unknown freshness and qualitative confidence are metadata. Syntactic topic conflict does not evaluate semantic truth; no automatic decay or belief update rule is implemented.
Source IDs preserve declared dependence but do not verify authentic or independent evidence. Copies do not increase confidence.

Actor policies must receive detached fresh snapshots only. The trusted store and EventHistory contain private data and are not actor interfaces; Python introspection is not a hostile-code isolation boundary. Historical snapshots are not current permissions.

No randomness is used by the mechanism; exhaustive access combinations and deterministic fixture replay establish structural behavior only, not population statistics, save/resume, concurrency or cross-owner atomicity.

AE-003 passed at entry. The required assumptions update makes only that predecessor binding historical; archived entry bytes match it and all other bindings remain unchanged. The actual expected post-edit predecessor checker failure is retained.
TDD red is an actual missing-module collection failure, not a pre-existing behavior assertion failure. Initial 37 tests passed; final strengthened suite has 41 focused and 85 total tests.
Shared ledger and ADR register are outside the allowed paths; the scoped handoff is in research/experiments/AE-004/review.md.

The single permitted git add attempt failed with exit 128 because shared Git metadata is read-only. No worker commit exists. Launch-specific delivery policy requires final status failed and controller/operator commit recovery; no staging retry or push was attempted.
test_method: Pre-implementation missing-API red, green, then strengthened negative/boundary/invariant and identity controls; deterministic replay with reversed registration. No stochastic seeds or simulated participants.

predecessor_review.disposition: pass at entry; required successor assumptions edit archived
